A '''Kerkoiden commander''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWn" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] participated in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] and commanded [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]]. During the battle, the [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] when the commander came out of his [[Tank/Legends|tank]] and looked to the sky to observe the Confederacy's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], which had been deactivated.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tank commander first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="TCWn" />
